Chapter 834: Chapter 29: Refining The Ultimate Weapon (Please Subscribe)_2

Chapter 834: Chapter 29: Refining the Ultimate Weapon (Please Subscribe)_2

A weapon that perfectly fits oneself is not only capable of perceiving more power of the twelve-stage but can also deeply explore the might of this ultimate weapon.

Unfortunately.

The ultimate weapon of the Four Divine Kings, along with the departure of ‘White Paper,’ was completely lost in the Two-dimensional World, resulting in the loss of core spiritual will.

This caused the Four Divine Kings to fall from the top echelon of Level Eleven Perfect legendary beings in one fell swoop.

…

There’s no need to elaborate on how an ultimate weapon enhances combat capabilities.

...

Even if a Level Eleven Perfect legendary being gets an ultimate weapon that is not quite suitable for them,

when fully activated, it can still unleash the might of hundreds of times its battle strength. The activation here relies solely on one’s own strength without any backups from a transcendent being left in the ultimate weapon.

On the basis of a Level Eleven Perfect legendary being’s combat power of ten, to explode with the might of hundreds demonstrates the deterrence of an ultimate weapon.

Ten to hundreds? This certainly does not mean a mere tenfold increase. A Level Eleven Perfect legendary being wielding an ultimate weapon can easily sweep away a group of legendary beings without such weapons.

Of course, a Level Eleven Perfect legendary being, when wielding an ultimate weapon, can explode with might far beyond their own limits.

But similarly, the energy expenditure to activate the ultimate weapon is also enormously terrifying. With the foundation of a Level Eleven Perfect legendary being, it’s impossible to wield the ultimate weapon more than a few times.

…

“Ultimate weapons… I have many of them.”

Lin Yuan’s thoughts stirred, and the Taiyang Divine Spirit entered the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

In the Cosmic Starry Skies of the Main Universe, when it comes to the number of ultimate weapons, Lin Yuan is unrivaled below the twelve-stage – no one dares to claim second place.

The number of curiosities collected by Lin Yuan in his journey to the Two-dimensional World is close to a hundred.

Even if most of these hundred items are Twelve-Star rare materials, the number of ultimate weapons still exceeds thirty.

Thirty ultimate weapons? Although it may not be as rich as the treasure vault of a peak race, it’s enough to make any Level Eleven Perfect legendary being look up to them.

In fact, they can’t even look up to them.

Nearly all Level Eleven Perfect legendary beings’ ultimate weapons are ‘temporarily borrowed’ from their race.

…

Swoosh.

Lin Yuan’s figure appeared at the deepest part of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

This is also where many curiosities are stored.

“Ultimate weapons…”

With a thought, thirty-two ultimate weapons appeared before Lin Yuan.

The thirty-two ultimate weapons were neatly arranged, including knives, spears, cauldrons, towers, and a variety of others.

“Now I can actually pick a few ultimate weapons.”

Lin Yuan stroked his chin.

Previously, Lin Yuan did not choose an ultimate weapon because he wanted to refine them.

Even preliminary refining requires the understanding of the Fusion of Time and Space at the Fifth Realm.

Without reaching the Fifth Realm of time-space understanding, it is impossible to activate the vast time-space inside the ultimate weapon, let alone refine it.

That is to say, to refine an ultimate weapon, one must start at the Sixth Tier of Level Eleven, and in reality, most owners of ultimate weapons are at the Sixth Tier.

That is, Level Eleven Perfect legendary beings.

Before Lin Yuan’s tenth spatial traversal, his understanding of space-time was only at the Second Realm, so naturally, he had no thoughts of refining ultimate weapons.

But now? Lin Yuan’s understanding of space-time has reached the Sixth Realm, allowing him not only to refine ultimate weapons but also to do it much faster than those Level Eleven Perfect legendary beings.

Moreover, a higher understanding of space-time is also very helpful in unlocking the power of ultimate weapons.

An ultimate weapon, in the hands of a transcendent being, can display the might of hundreds of thousands and even millions in battle strength.

But in the hands of a Level Eleven Perfect legendary being, it can merely exert hundreds? The exploration of ultimate weapons by Level Eleven Perfect beings is not even considered trivial.

“Let’s take a look.”

Lin Yuan carefully selected among the thirty-two ultimate weapons, which required serious contemplation.

Although in Lin Yuan’s heart, the most suitable ultimate weapon would be the Origin Clock, it is still far from transforming into an ultimate weapon.

Before that happens, Lin Yuan doesn’t mind using a few ultimate weapons as a stopgap.

Even if these ultimate weapons are not very suitable for him, their inherently high-quality nature can still significantly enhance his combat capability.

“This iron staff…”

Lin Yuan looked at a pitch-black iron staff.

This iron staff was the first offensive weapon Lin Yuan obtained in the Two-dimensional World.

Even when confined within the Two-dimensional World and subject to dimensional suppression, the staff’s revealed aura was extremely powerful, filled with an overwhelming sense of weight.

Once freed from the Two-dimensional World and arriving in the Main Universe, the staff’s innate power began to partially recover. Picking up this iron staff, the energy Lin Yuan would expend could probably lift tens of thousands of stars.

“Let’s see if it feels right.”

With a thought, Lin Yuan moved to the high skies of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

In the Two-dimensional World, Lin Yuan used the pitch-black iron staff numerous times, but that staff in the Two-dimensional World was completely different from the current one.

With the restoration of twelve-stage power, the staff in Lin Yuan’s hands felt like it could crush the stars themselves.

Whoosh.

Lin Yuan held the pitch-black iron staff and casually swung it forward.

A terrifying dark shadow emerged, and a black spatial crack tens of thousands of miles long was fiercely torn through the void of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

Before an initial refining of an ultimate weapon, if one has a high enough understanding of the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule, it is possible to unleash some power of the ultimate weapon in advance.

However, compared to after preliminary refining, the power would be much lower, and the energy expenditure even greater.
